text: 你发现一条绕过岩石突出部的狭窄岩架。在你们帮助下，伯纳德得以通过；猿人身材过于魁梧，无法跟上。它们愤怒地咕哝着退开。你们沿路返回山脚下的草甸。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 625
text: You spy a narrow ledge that rounds a rocky outcrop. With help, Bernard is able to navigate it. The ape-men, however, are a little too bulky. Grunting in frustration, they fall back. Your party traces a route back to the meadowland at the foot of the hill.
